about: The directory's Agent Card bodies, one per (assistant on or off) x (area named or not), with {origin}, {org}, {purl} and {area} slots that card.go fills before signing. Go source since 19 Nov 2026 (it was modules/discovery/card.ts directoryCard).

plain-none.name: Directory of local shops
plain-none.description: Finds what local shops have: pets, food, clothes, things for the home and more. Search in English, Hindi, Malayalam or Kannada. Results come in a fair order (the best fit, then the nearest, shops at the same distance take turns; never by payment, plan or Operator) and each is confirmed with its shop when the shop answers. The order is explained at {origin}/order.

skills.name: Search what local shops have
skills.description: Words, a category (pets, food, clothes, home, electronics, vehicles_and_cycles, services, other), the buyer's map point or town and a radius in; listings in the fair order out, each confirmed by its shop where the shop answers. Also at GET /search.

skills.name: One listing, confirmed
skills.description: One listing by its shop's page address and id, with its words in every language and the shop's own confirmation that it is still there.
examples: Is l-3 at https://streetlist.in/rani-pets/ still there?

skills.name: One shop
skills.description: A shop's name, trade, town, chat address and the listings it has.

skills.name: Ask in the buyer's own words
skills.description: The buyer's words in (English, Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada or Latin letters); a typed search (words, category, place, radius, highest price), the listings in the fair order and a short line in the buyer's language out. Phone numbers, names and addresses are removed before any model sees the words, and a shop never receives them. Within a daily and monthly cap; over it, the words are searched as given. Also by POST /search/ask (a form, so the words are not in an address).
